title: formatCurrency for cents
prompt: Add formatMoney(cents, currency) to src/money.js and export it. It takes an integer number of minor units (cents) and a currency code, and returns a display string. Examples: formatMoney(123456, "USD") is "$1,234.56", formatMoney(500, "EUR") is "€5.00". Support USD, EUR and GBP (£), and throw for any other code. Reject anything that is not an integer (including NaN) by throwing an Error.
